descriptor: Flashcard study app with spaced review

voice.summary: Recall sounds like a good study partner: short prompts, quick praise and no fuss between cards. It keeps attention on the answer instead of on itself.
dos: Use two-word prompts like 'I knew it' and 'Need review'
Praise effort, not just a perfect score
Show the shortcut key next to each action
donts: Pad card feedback with extra words

taglines: Say it before you see it
boilerplate: Recall is a flashcard app that uses spaced repetition to bring back the words people are about to forget, with keyboard shortcuts and a short summary after each session.

microcopy.error: Could not save your progress. Try again.
microcopy.empty: No cards due. Come back tomorrow.

logo.note: An open book is the quickest picture of study and sits easily beside a card flip.
